name: costa-rica-corporate-income-tax
description: Costa Rica corporate income tax (impuesto sobre las utilidades) source reference for ordinary domiciled companies (sociedad anónima, sociedad de responsabilidad limitada) for fiscal period 2026. Covers territorial scope, the 30% rate, the small-company scale and its gross-income cliff, the Mipyme reduction, the base, loss carry-forward, partial payments, the TRIBU-CR form 102 return, payment and penalties. Trigger on Costa Rica company tax, impuesto sobre las utilidades, persona jurídica, pagos parciales, D-101, formulario 102 or TRIBU-CR. Includes recomputing fictional cases and explicit source holds. This Tier 2 draft awaits professional review and does not establish filing readiness.
